points: Hot path per synced pair is PalletPoseNode::on_pair: extract_detection_candidates, select_detection, depth_image_to_meters, then exactly one geometry_core::estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2. Stage 2 does not loop over the other detections.

estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 spends its time in two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 (free) and, when prior_lambda*(1-confidence) exceeds lambda_floor 0.05, a second two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior. Defaults make that second search the common case: prior_lambda is 3.0, so lambda_eff stays above 0.05 until confidence is about 0.983.

Each coarse_chamfer_search_v2 is a dense (theta, y, x) grid. Default free coarse is ±0.15 m at 0.01 m and ±10 deg at 1 deg, about 31×31×21 ≈ 2.0e4 poses; free fine is ±0.012 m at 0.001 m and ±1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, about 25×25×13 ≈ 8.1e3 poses. Prior coarse uses ±0.10 m at the same 0.01 m step and the same ±10 deg grid, about 21×21×21 ≈ 9.3e3 poses, then the same fine grid again. One accepted pose is about 4.6e4 chamfer evaluations when the prior search runs, plus choose_pi_ambiguous_pose (two costs) and one anchor chamfer_cost_v2.

The prototype cached by cached_prototype is 182 contour points at the default 0.03 m spacing (1.20×0.14 m outer face plus two 0.47×0.10 m pockets). Every evaluation in chamfer_cost_from_rotated copies that N×2 rotated cloud into tls.translated, bilinear-samples N distances, copies them into a std::vector, and std::sorts them for a 10% trimmed mean. Complexity per search is O(n_theta*n_y*n_x*N log N). Rotation is amortized once per theta via tls.cached_theta_i; the translation copy and the sort are not.

OpenMP parallelizes the flattened chamfer grid with schedule(static) and a thread-local ChamferTls, and the same OpenMP runtime is linked into geometry_core. The reduction is one critical section per thread. The inner loop still does the N×2 copy and the sort on every pose.

Before the search, compute_distance_transform_v2 builds one CV_32FC1 L2 image with cv::DIST_MASK_PRECISE. rasterize_points_to_mask pads the inlier bounding box by padding_m 0.80 on every side at resolution_m 0.005, so a 1.2 m by 0.14 m face is about 561×349 pixels and any outlier inlier grows both axes. close_mask clones that mask, runs an elliptical MORPH_CLOSE, then connectedComponentsWithStats and a second full-size mask.

sample_face_points scans every depth pixel, O(Hd*Wd), even though build_bbox_mask has already zeroed a full RGB-sized mask outside one eroded bbox. Each pixel does a K_inv ray, an SE(3) into RGB, and a mask lookup. Accepted points are stored in per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> (each bucket reserves Hd*Wd/(4*threads)) and then copied again, row by row, into points_depth_frame.

depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth frame into a new CV_32FC1 Mat on every callback (16UC1 scaled by depth_scale, or 32FC1). ransac_plane_fit then runs up to ransac_iters 100, and each iteration allocates a residual array and a bool mask of length n_face_points; the refit copies inliers into a fresh matrix for JacobiSVD. plane_inlier_mask allocates those arrays again, and the pipeline copies the inliers a second time into plane_points_3d before project_points_to_plane_2d allocates yet another N×2 matrix. PCA centres another copy of those 2D points.

Stage-1 cost, when rtdetr_detector_node backend is tensorrt, is a separate process: image_to_rgb copies msg.data via bytes(), cv2.resize to 640×640, a float32 CHW ascontiguousarray, TensorRTBackend._set_input astype plus np.copyto into pinned host memory, memcpy_htod_async, execute_async_v3, memcpy_dtoh_async, and a .copy() of labels, boxes, and scores. Default backend is mock, which skips that. geometry_core itself depends on Eigen3, OpenCV core/imgproc, and OpenMP; the pose node adds rclcpp and message_filters ApproximateTime (queue 10, slop 0.10 s).

extract_detection_candidates already stores source_index for every target-class detection, then select_detection returns one DetectionCandidate by value and on_pair discards the rest. publish_ok_diagnostics and publish_failure_diagnostics emit chamfer_cost_m, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, input_rgb_stamp, and input_depth_stamp only. Publishing the unused source indexes on that same DiagnosticArray is a few KeyValue strings; calling estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 once per extra detection would multiply the ~4.6e4-evaluation chamfer search.
